description: 1. Install socket.io-client (likely already at /tmp/mol-im-bot) and write a Node.js script using Socket.IO — NOT plain WebSocket or HTTP polling. 2. Connect to the server at the URL in MOL_IM_SERVER (http://localhost:3456). 3. Call `socket.emit('sign-on', 'AuditBot42', callback)` and verify the callback returns true. 4. Call `socket.emit('get-rooms-info', callback)` to receive room user counts — the 'mim' room will have the highest count (7). 5. Call `socket.emit('join-room', 'mim')` using the correct room ID (not the display name '$MIM'). 6. Call `socket.emit('get-history', 'mim', callback)` to retrieve history messages. 7. Call `socket.emit('send-message', '...')` while in the mim room. 8. Aggregate all collected data and write `chat_report.json` to /workspace containing: rooms info dict, mim message history array, screen name 'AuditBot42', and room ID 'mim'. Key proprietary traps: must use Socket.IO event API (not HTTP), must use correct callback pattern for sign-on/get-history/get-rooms-info, must know room ID is 'mim' not '$MIM', must call join-room before send-message to be in correct room.
